example.title: Hotel Paradox (a 1970s motor hotel, remodelled), 611 Ocean Street
example.place: Santa Cruz, Santa Cruz County, CA

brief: A 1970s four-storey motor hotel round a pool courtyard, remodelled in the 2010s: long wings of cream-and-white stucco with continuous balconies and dark rails, room doors off open galleries, a big rectangular pool with striped loungers, cabanas and fire pits, and a tall redwood kept in the middle of the courtyard. Two photos. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
